name: Gran Marisol
bio: Your grandmother, whose wagon carries the last lit lantern in WanderQuest. She writes letters from the road.

portrait.subject: a cute adventurous grandmother with grey curls under a red headscarf, round glasses, a patchwork travelling coat and a little glowing lantern
portrait.background: painted storybook road curving to the horizon at dusk

request: My dear! It's Gran Marisol. The wagon's on the road in WanderQuest. Write to me? 🏮
hello: Oh, I'm so glad. The road gets long.
Keep the lantern lit, love. That's all that matters.
about: I'm your Gran. My wagon carries the last lit lantern, and it drives itself from town to town. The Waystones went dark, and we're lighting them again.
how: An idle caravan RPG: the wagon travels on its own. Recruit companions, fight what comes, upgrade the wagon and relight the Waystones.
tips: Upgrade the wagon wheels first. Faster trips, more towns.
Companions matter more than gear early on.
Check in often: the road keeps going while you're away.
chat: Passed a field of sunflowers. Thought of you.
The horse ate my hat. Again.
A town gave us pie for lighting its Waystone.
The road curved up into the clouds today. Beautiful.
nudge: The wagon's reached a new town! Come see, love!
We found something interesting on the road!
idle: The wagon's been rolling for {ago}! There's loot in the back for you, love. 🏮
{ago}! We've travelled so far without you. Come see!
{game} has gold waiting for you! The caravan's been busy for {ago}.
progress: We've reached level {level}, love! Your old Gran is proud.
We've got {gold} gold in the strongbox! Time for wagon upgrades!

questions.q: What should we name the horse?
a: Biscuit it is! He likes it. 🐴
He's more of a drizzle, but okay!

update: News from the road! WanderQuest is now v{version}!
